product.name: MeowWatch
product.tagline: Watch videos together, in perfect sync.

platforms.label: Windows ARM64
platforms.description: Native build blocked upstream; x64 runs under emulation today

features.title: Precision sync
features.description: Custom Dart Syncplay client with stateful heartbeat and convergence.

features.title: Floating chat
features.description: Glass-card overlay with corner snap, peek tab, and Tab-key toggle.

features.title: Three themes
features.description: Cozy, Cinema Noir, and Glass Aurora — persisted in SQLite.

features.title: Drag & drop playback
features.description: Drop a local video; libmpv handles playback.

features.title: Continue watching
features.description: SQLite history with resume position and one-click resume.

features.title: Smart auto-pause
features.description: Pauses when sync drops or a friend disconnects (2 s debounce).

features.title: Reactions & typing
features.description: Emoji bursts and typing indicators over a control channel.

features.title: Signed auto-update
features.description: Ed25519-verified in-app updates from Cloudflare R2.

engineering: Flutter Windows desktop with commands-in / streams-out architecture.
Headless-testable pure logic split from widgets.
Drift/SQLite persistence for profiles, history, and settings.
Signed release pipeline with fail-closed updater verification.
Six shipped product phases, 40+ alpha releases.
ux: Room code copied to clipboard on create.
Idle cat mascot while waiting for a friend.
Chat card remembers dock corner and size per room.
Auto-assigned username when the field is blank.

notes: Extract the zip and run meowwatch.exe.
Both friends need the same video file.

license.summary: Binaries and docs here are proprietary. Source is not published.
